title: Upread v1: one-word-at-a-time reader for PDFs and pasted links
task: Build Upread, a Vite + TypeScript Home Screen web app (manifest name "Upread", display standalone). Dark screen shows one word at a time, large and centred, with one red pivot letter about 35% into each word held at a fixed position. Speed slider 150–900 wpm, default 300, remembered in localStorage. Pauses: 1.5x after commas, 2x after sentence ends, longer for words over 8 letters. Tap to pause, swipe left to go back one sentence, draggable progress bar, reading position saved per document. PDFs: text extracted on the phone with a bundled pdf.js (no upload); scanned PDFs with no text show a clear "no text found" message. Links: a Vercel function at api/extract.ts fetches a pasted URL server-side and returns only the article text (Readability-style), and passes PDF links through the same PDF extraction; the PBS Commanding Heights site (https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/commandingheights/) must work, including its story and interview pages. Tests (npm test, offline): tokenizer, pause timing, article extraction on a bundled sample HTML page, and the opening words of a bundled sample PDF. The built dist loads nothing from external hosts.
